segments.title: Holiday Broadcast Planning
segments.notes: Anchor Case Blackwell outlines New Year's Eve award stream sub goal and discusses electric brush attachments with studio contributor Kendelle.

segments.title: Subscription Surge Derailment
segments.notes: Massive sub gifts from CV loves you (100) and tamtrant (30) trigger Hype Train; anchor designates 'CV loves you Cream Team New Year's Stream' sponsorship and unveils nipple-themed graphics.

segments.title: Lethal Company Cooperative Session
segments.notes: Extended cooperative gameplay with Kendelle, Crum, and rotating guest crew; no traditional news content aired.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored an extended holiday gaming broadcast, managed a massive subscription surge, and confirmed New Year's Eve special scheduling.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Appeared as in-studio co-player for Lethal Company session and shared personal anecdote about her mother's pug.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Participated in cooperative gameplay, continuing pattern of high-risk playstyle resulting in frequent early deaths.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell confirms New Year's Eve broadcast scheduled for Sunday mid-afternoon, prioritizing schedules of major subscribers CV loves you and tamtrant.
Kendelle reveals her mother's pug gave birth at 10 months old, impregnated by its biological father, and accidentally smothered a puppy.
'CV loves you Cream Team New Year's Stream' sponsorship established with nipple-themed graphics.
Arbitrary sub goal set for New Year's 'best of the year' award stream.

episode_summary: Anchor Case Blackwell hosted an extended holiday gaming broadcast featuring Lethal Company cooperative play with studio contributor Kendelle and debate analyst Crum. A massive subscription surge triggered an unscheduled Hype Train segment, resulting in the 'CV loves you Cream Team New Year's Stream' sponsorship. The broadcast concluded with a raid handoff and confirmation of a New Year's Eve special.
